title: AI-Builder-Club/skills
why_good: A codebase harness + 'loop engineer' skill set — useful scaffolding for agent coding, but it reads as a harness/skill bundle, not a product.
value: Hard to monetize a harness directly; the value is know-how, at best a paid template/skill pack.
risk: Harness/skill bundles get absorbed by Claude Code/Cursor; near-zero moat as a standalone.
